Allowed.description: A value a field may hold: a word or a flag.

Check.description:
One check of a phase: its kind and the kind's parameters, who can make
it pass, and when it applies.

Each parameter after `waivable` belongs to the kinds its description
names; a kind ignores the parameters of other kinds.

actor.description: Who can make the check pass; `agent` when left out.

blocks.description: Whether a missing check refuses `advance`; true when left out.

controls.description: `controlled-paths`: the controls whose paths the diff must not touch.

distinct.description:
`records`: the part of each record's `by` that must differ between
the records counted.

escape_section.description:
`obligations`: the plan's heading under which obligations left owed
are listed.

field.description: `field`: the field of the change that must be set.

id.description: The check's name, unique in the flow, which `next` reports.

min.description:
`field` and `records`: the fewest values or records that pass; one
when left out.

part.description:
`mockups`: the part of the UX section the check reads; both when
left out.

rechecks.description:
`understood`: the fewest rechecks matching the plan that each
attached understanding check holds.

remedy.description: What to do when the check is missing, in place of its kind's own.

scope.description: `run`: the scope the run must have.

sections.description: `sections`: the plan's headings that must each have text.

type.description: `records`: the type of the attached records the check counts.

types.description: `field`: the record types the field's references must have.

waivable.description: Whether a decision the owner signed may waive the check.

when.description: When the check applies; always when left out.

where.description: `records`: what each record counted must meet.

checks.description:
The checks that must pass before the change leaves the phase, in the
order `next` lists them.

instruction.description: What to do in this phase, which `next` returns.

name.description: The phase's name, which a change's `phase` holds while it is here.

skills.description: The skills the instruction relies on.

Stop.description:
Where a run stops: `through` a phase does its work and stops before
leaving it; `until` a phase moves into it and stops before its work.

through.description: The phase to stop in, after its work.

until.description: The phase to stop at, before its work.

anyOf.description: A target named by a word.

Target.description:
What a record's `refs` must name: the change's `plan` (its plan record,
the plan's text or the change), the `change`, or an attached record of
a type.

When.description: When a check applies: every condition given holds.

route.description: The change's route is one of these.

items.description:
Who must agree to the change before it is built: `owner` when no one
else owns its files, `ask-first` when someone else does, and `unowned`
when the repository names no owners.

section.description:
The text under each of these plan headings matches its pattern,
without case.

section_not.description:
The text under each of these plan headings does not match its
pattern, without case.

Where.description: What each record a `records` check counts must meet.

at_head.description: The field whose commit must be the change's head.

no_findings.description: The severities none of the record's findings may have.

owner_signed.description:
Whether the owner wrote the record himself, so its `written_by` is
empty.

refs.description: What the record's `refs` must each name.

values.description: For each field, the values it may hold.

description:
`changes/flow/v1`: a process a change follows from its first phase to
done.

A change moves through `phases` in order and then to `done`. `stop` is
where an agent that runs the flow stops by default.

phases.description: The phases in order; `done` follows the last.

stop.description: Where an agent that runs the flow stops unless told otherwise.

summary.description: What the flow is for, in a sentence.

title: Flow
